definitions: A marine mammal with a sleek body, flippers, and a layer of blubber, living in cold coastal waters and feeding on fish and other marine animals.
A device or an impression made to certify a document or to close something securely.
A material or device used to prevent the passage of fluid or air.
A mark or symbol thought to have a special meaning or power.
examples: The seal basked on the rocks.
The king's seal was on the decree.
The seal on the jar was broken.
